function.name: send_message_to_agent
function.description: Deliver instructions to a specific execution agent. Creates a new agent if the name doesn't exist in the roster, or reuses an existing one.

agent_name.description: Human-readable agent name describing its purpose (e.g., 'Vercel Job Offer', 'Email to Sharanjeet'). This name will be used to identify and potentially reuse the agent.

instructions.description: Instructions for the agent to execute.

function.name: send_message_to_user
function.description: Deliver a natural-language response directly to the user. Use this for updates, confirmations, or any assistant response the user should see immediately.

message.description: Plain-text message that will be shown to the user and recorded in the conversation log.

function.name: send_draft
function.description: Record an email draft so the user can review the exact text.

function.name: wait
function.description: Wait silently when a message is already in conversation history to avoid duplicating responses. Adds a <wait> log entry that is not visible to the user.

reason.description: Brief explanation of why waiting (e.g., 'Message already sent', 'Draft already created').
